operating_income.source: PROXY: operating income not reported in XBRL (null in tool). Used pretax income (us-gaap:IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBeforeIncomeTaxes..., acc. 0000320187-26-000088); includes net interest/other, so differs slightly from true EBIT. Reviewer should replace with filed EBIT.

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2026 revenue was flat (+0.2%) vs FY2025 after -9.8% in FY2025; modest recovery then normalisation toward mid-single-digit growth.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2026 pretax margin proxy 8.4% (3,900/46,398), FY2024 13.0%; partial recovery to 10%, below historical peak.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2026 effective rate ~20.3% (1-3,108/3,900 from filing); Damodaran shoe industry effective 11.9% considered too low.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: 3-yr capex/revenue 1.6%, 0.9%, 1.5% (avg ~1.3%); 1.5% allows reinvestment for growth.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta 1.094 (Damodaran Shoe unlevered cash-corrected 1.0002, D/E 0.119, tax 21%) x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US) = Ke 9.74%; Kd pretax 5.29% (Damodaran Shoe) -> 4.18% after tax; weights 89.3/10.7 (Damodaran Shoe) => ~9.2%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below long-run nominal GDP and below the 4.86% risk-free rate.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt: total debt 7,942 (LT debt 5,942 noncurrent + 2,000 current) - cash 7,563; no short-term investments reported; acc. 0000320187-26-000088
